connector.name: TensorFeed x402 Base Reader
connector.registryDescription: Read-only Base mainnet reader. Verifies x402 payment settlements + AFTA federation status.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package x402-base-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.tensorfeed, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: TENSORFEED_RPC_URL
env.description: Optional Base mainnet RPC endpoint (Alchemy, Infura, etc) for higher rate limits. Must match the allowlist in src/rpc/allowlist.ts; non-allowlisted URLs fall back to public Base RPC with a stderr warning. Defaults to https://mainnet.base.org if unset.
